onboarding:cta.next__note: Advances to the next onboarding slide.
onboarding:welcome.body: Discover the world with Atlas, one short lesson at a time.
onboarding:welcome.body__note: First welcome screen, below WorldQuest and the clay Atlas hero. Introduces the guide and gives a short, concrete learning promise. Keep it welcoming and concise; no artificial urgency.
onboarding:cta.start__note: Primary button on the welcome frame — the first thing anybody ever taps. Moved here from the last value slide, which now says Continue like every other forward step: two buttons reading "Get started" in one flow is one of them lying about being the start.
onboarding:cta.haveAccount__note: Secondary action for returning users. Never styled as the primary.
onboarding:cta.skip__note: Skips the value slides. Always available — never trap a user in a carousel.
onboarding:age.title: When were you born?
onboarding:age.title__note: Age gate headline. Neutral date entry — NEVER 'are you over 13?', which teaches children to lie.
onboarding:age.body: This sets up the right experience for you. We don't share it with anyone.
onboarding:age.body__note: Explains why we ask. Must be true: the value stays on device until an account exists.
onboarding:age.year__note: Names the birth-year wheel for a screen reader — announced as the radiogroup label, not drawn on screen.
onboarding:age.continue__note: Confirms the birth year and moves to the goal picker.
onboarding:age.child.title: We'll keep things simple
onboarding:age.child.title__note: Shown to under-13s. Framed as a feature, never as a restriction or a punishment.
onboarding:age.child.body: No friends list, no ads, and nothing shared with anyone else. Just the learning.
onboarding:age.child.body__note: Explains the child branch in plain words a 10-year-old can read.
onboarding:goal.title: How much a day?
onboarding:goal.body: You can change this any time in Settings.
onboarding:goal.body__note: Reassurance under the goal picker. Reduces the weight of the choice.
onboarding:goal.minutes__note: A daily goal option. {minutes} is 5, 10 or 20.
onboarding:goal.casual__note: Label for the 5-minute goal. Never framed as the lazy option.
onboarding:taster.title: Let's try one
onboarding:taster.title__note: Headline before the taster lesson. The user learns BEFORE we ask for an account.
onboarding:taster.body: One short lesson. No account needed.
onboarding:taster.body__note: Removes the expected friction. This promise must stay true.
onboarding:progress__note: Accessibility label for the onboarding progress BAR, which counts the four steps of the whole flow. Read aloud by screen readers.
onboarding:back__note: Accessibility label for the control that steps ONE question back in onboarding. Never rendered visibly — the control is an icon — so this string exists only for screen readers and should be the plain word the platform uses for going back, not a sentence. Same word as `common:back`, and deliberately its own key: this one steps within the form rather than leaving the screen, and a translator may need different words for that in a language where the two are not the same verb.
onboarding:plan.title: Here is your plan.
onboarding:plan.title__note: Atlas says this at the top of the summary step, after the last question. A statement, not a question — it is the one step that tells rather than asks.
onboarding:plan.body: You can change any of this later in Settings.
onboarding:plan.body__note: Reassurance under the summary. The whole point is that none of the answers just given are binding.
onboarding:plan.pace__note: Label for the row showing the daily goal the user chose. Paired with a value like "10 min".
onboarding:plan.start__note: Label for the row showing which continent the user chose, or "The whole world" if they chose anywhere.
onboarding:plan.level__note: Label for the row showing the self-assessed level. Paired with a value like "I know some".
onboarding:plan.world__note: The value shown for the favourite-region row when the user picked no particular continent.
onboarding:plan.week: {minutes, plural, one {That is # minute a week.} other {That is # minutes a week.}}
onboarding:plan.week__note: Plain arithmetic on the chosen daily goal — minutes per day times seven. Deliberately NOT a claim about how much anyone will learn: this repo does not ship numbers it cannot source, and nobody has measured what a week of this app teaches. {minutes} is an integer.
onboarding:slide.position__note: Accessibility label for one dot in the intro carousel, which counts the three slides INSIDE step one. It used the bar's string, so a reader heard 'Step 2 of 4' from the bar and 'Step 1 of 3' from the dot beneath it — two answers to the same question. Different word for a different thing.
onboarding:age.none__note: The wheel's first row, and where it opens. Nothing is pre-selected here on purpose: this answer decides whether a child gets the child experience, so it must never be nudged. Phrase it as an invitation, never as an error or a missing value.
onboarding:language.title: Choose your language
onboarding:language.title__note: First onboarding step, before anything else. Kept short because it is read by somebody who may not read this language well.
onboarding:language.body: You can change this any time in Settings.
onboarding:language.body__note: Reassurance under the language picker. Same promise as the goal step, worded the same way on purpose.
onboarding:language.system__note: The default language option — follows the device setting. Phrased from the user’s side rather than as "System default", which is a settings-menu phrase.
onboarding:region.title: Where would you like to explore?
onboarding:region.title__note: Asks for a favourite region used in free practice. The course and introductory lesson start with world foundations regardless of this preference.
onboarding:region.body: Choose a favourite region for free practice. Your course starts with world foundations.
onboarding:region.body__note: Explains the distinction between the free-practice region preference and the fixed opening course.
onboarding:region.anywhere__note: The opt-out on the continent step. Not "skip" — it is a legitimate preference, and the majority answer for an adult user.
onboarding:level.title: How well do you know the world?
onboarding:level.title__note: Self-assessed level. Sets how hard the first lessons are; the scheduler takes over from the user’s real answers within a session or two.
onboarding:level.body: Choose a starting difficulty. You can change it in Settings.
onboarding:level.body__note: Phase 1 claim review, 2026-09-13. Describe current practice/account availability without promising retention, complete world coverage or cross-device recovery. Keep ICU placeholders unchanged.
onboarding:level.new__note: Easiest level. Never "beginner" or "novice" — a label a ten-year-old would read as being put in the slow group.
onboarding:level.newBody: Start with the ones everyone knows.
onboarding:level.newBody__note: Description of the easiest level, matching the shape of someBody and confidentBody. It named three example countries until a review pointed out that country names are facts and live in content packs, never in a locale file — and a translator would have had to decide whether to localise them, which is a decision no translator should be handed.
onboarding:level.someBody: A mix, from the famous to the tricky.
onboarding:level.confident__note: Hardest level. Playful rather than "advanced" — it is a challenge being accepted, not a rank being claimed.
onboarding:level.confidentBody: Straight to the ones people get wrong.
